title: SELECTCOLUMNS without a name keeps the model name of a plain column reference

source.quote: The <Name> argument can be skipped if the correspondent <Expression> argument is a simple column reference of the iterated table
source.supports: the name may be left out

source.quote: -- Both column name and data lineage -- are 'Product'[Product Name]
source.supports: the unnamed column keeps the full column name

derivation: The column is a plain reference, so it is returned as Product[Color], with the 4 rows of Product.
